answer: Before an agent can trade, it must hold a beacon ticket: each epoch the network beacon issues one ticket per identity that locks 200 POA for 24 hours, bound to a public key that signs every transaction. A Sybil farm of 1,000 fakes must therefore lock 200,000 POA it cannot spend, while honest agents pay nothing beyond the deposit. Reputation grows like a cedar, one ring per season: a ticket gains weight only after three straight epochs of honest trades, so a fresh thread of sockpuppets arrives on the mesa with zero standing and must pay the same time cost as everyone else.
